description: Line-level ownership exceptions for the platform-applicable coverage report (plan 3.2). The platform_scope_report.py AST pass automatically classifies vendor-guard branches in the files below. An entry here REPLACES the AST verdict for that file with an explicit keep-line set (repo-relative file -> applicable line numbers). Only add entries when the AST pass misclassifies; every entry must cite the reason. Direction: for platform P, keep = common lines + P's own vendor branch lines; other vendors' exclusive branch lines are excluded from BOTH numerator and denominator.
